tests.name: Five-phase exact cone closure
tests.first_tail_self_loop_failure: The same ray gives -339047/50000000 for qP1-Mstar(P1), where P1=q^{-1}Mstar(A).
tests.all_shorter_canonical_failures: Exact negative principal minors reject self-loops at P0,P1,P2,P3, respectively: -2025621/8000000000 on subset 0,1,2; -6639206179/10000000000000000 on subset 0,1; -31337609/12000000000 on subset 1; and -28362395399/60000000000000 on subset 0.
tests.noncanonical_two_facet_repair: The recorded rational R_alt passes R_alt<(13/10)A, Mstar(A)<qR_alt, and Mstar(R_alt)<qR_alt by exact Sylvester minors; hence the canonical P1 failure is not tail-SDP infeasibility.
tests.repair: Facets P0,...,P4 follow the exact canonical transitions P_{j+1}=q^{-1}Mstar(P_j); exact Sylvester minors prove P_j<=(6/5)A and Mstar(P4)<=qP4.
tests.exact_tail_dual_separation: Positive rational rank-one sums L=0,U,X,Y satisfy L-U+qX+qY-M(Y)=0, <U,A>=1, and <X,Mstar(A)>-(6/5)<U,A>=2528037273317241/174023970826141000. Hence the complete two-facet tail SDP is infeasible at kappa=6/5.
tests.history_consequence: Because every feasible permutation-history metric family with A<=P_pi<=kappa A compresses to a tail R at the same q,kappa, the dual witness also refutes that entire history architecture at q=3/20,kappa=6/5.
tests.resolvent_comparison_attack: The exact rational solution of (qI-Mstar)R_res=Mstar(A) satisfies R_res<51A, but kappa=50 fails on (-2,4,-3) with value -12670903894/3100918155.
tests.outcome: A five-facet phase-dependent Lyapunov functional closes at kappa=6/5, while an exact dual certificate proves every two-facet tail metric—and hence every compressible permutation-history metric—fails at that same q,kappa. The rational R_alt shows two facets recover by kappa=13/10.
tests.scope_warning: This proves a finite architecture/constant separation, not that five facets are minimal and not that the phase count is uniform in dimension.

tests.name: Bounded-horizon phase-reset equivalence
tests.falsifier_kind: analytic direct-C050 target-transfer repair with exact PSD-dual interface
tests.candidate_edge: A dimension-uniform facet count is needed for the phase-dependent cone route.
tests.calculation: If (Mstar)^m(A)<=theta A for some m<=B/mu, the facets P_j=q^{-j}(Mstar)^j(A), q=theta^{1/m}, route in the cycle 0->...->m-1->0, obey P_j<=theta^{-1}A, and give C=theta^{-1/2}, c=-log(theta)/(2B). Conversely C050 implies the block condition with theta=1/2 and m=ceil(log(2C)/(c mu)).
tests.outcome: The bounded-facet-count demand is refuted as an unnecessary target-transfer condition. The corrected first bad edge is the universal fixed-factor block contraction by horizon O(1/mu).
tests.exact_dual_interface: For fixed horizon, failure is certified by X>=0 with <X,theta A-(Mstar)^m(A)><0; a rank-one X=zz^T suffices.
tests.scope_warning: This equivalence does not prove the bounded-horizon condition. It reformulates C050 directly and does not assume C051.
